references.name: whole-station-aerial.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected 2026 ordinary aerial: full parallel elevated track corridor with many open platform roofs; western repeated transverse low barrel/glazed canopy modules beside a long pale station range, and separate taller blue/rounded Pullman hotel; eastern old pale yellow brick office/entrance range with regular windows,flat stepped roofs and tall glass-block stair piers. Numerous independent office buildings beyond both streets. No trains,brands,graffiti,overhead-wire forests or proposed construction copied. The western hotel is a separate business and must remain native.

references.name: avenue-fonsny-entrance.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected Avenue Fonsny entrance: pale yellow brick street range with five upper window rows above gray stone base, tall recessed glass-block stair bay,pale structural window mullions and low connected entrance hall. Doors sit beneath deep recessed ground entrance. No flags,brands,poster images,people,cars or street trees copied. Exact hidden facades and service arrangements remain medium-fi interpretation.
